Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Passionate Area Rug, 6' 7" x 9' 6", Navy
Colors: Navy
Materials: stone
Add elegance to your home decor with this lovely rug. With a blue-focused color scheme and a distinct flourish pattern, this rug is a perfect match for traditional-style interior design. Its captivating design also pairs well with modern and vintage home-decor styles. 6'7" x 9'6" Pile: 100% polypropylene; backing: 100% jute Advanced power-loom construction for excellent value and quality Medium 0.5'' pile ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms
